_note: Twelve core skills. Specialties are categorised by the skill they are most commonly used with, but you do NOT need a level in that skill to hold the specialty.

skills.name: Close Combat
skills.desc: Fighting an enemy up close, with or without a melee weapon.

skills.name: Heavy Weapons
skills.desc: Machine guns, rocket launchers, mortars, tank guns and howitzers. Mounted weapons use AGL; artillery uses INT.

skills.name: Stamina
skills.desc: Physical toughness and endurance -- marching hard, resisting disease or cold, clinging to life.

skills.name: Mobility
skills.desc: Jumping, climbing, running fast, thrown weapons.

skills.name: Ranged Combat
skills.desc: Hand-held ranged weapons -- pistols, bows, submachineguns, assault rifles.

skills.name: Recon
skills.desc: Spotting concealed enemies, avoiding ambushes, moving silently.

skills.name: Survival
skills.desc: Finding food and shelter in the wild.

skills.name: Tech
skills.desc: Repairing gear, scavenging parts, crafting with a workshop.

skills.name: Command
skills.desc: Leading survivors, getting someone incapacitated by stress back on their feet. Sets unit morale.

skills.name: Medical Aid
skills.desc: Helping the injured back up and saving the life of a fallen comrade.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.desc: Charm, threats or reason -- making others see things your way.

_generally_available_note: printed p31 step 6 -- these three may always be chosen for a term's skill increases, whatever the career lists.

Close Combat.name: Brawler
Close Combat.desc: +1 to CLOSE COMBAT in unarmed close combat.

Close Combat.name: Melee
Close Combat.desc: +1 to CLOSE COMBAT with hand-to-hand weapons -- knives, bayonets, clubs.

Close Combat.name: Killer
Close Combat.desc: You can kill an incapacitated person outright with no negative effects.

Close Combat.name: Martial Artist
Close Combat.desc: Your unarmed attacks have a crit threshold of 3 instead of 4.

Heavy Weapons.name: Machinegunner
Heavy Weapons.desc: +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS firing machine guns.

Heavy Weapons.name: Launcher Crew
Heavy Weapons.desc: +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS firing grenade and missile launchers.

Heavy Weapons.name: Redleg
Heavy Weapons.desc: +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS firing mortars and howitzers.

Heavy Weapons.name: Vehicle Gunner
Heavy Weapons.desc: +1 to HEAVY WEAPONS firing vehicle-mounted cannons.

Stamina.name: Load Carrier
Stamina.desc: Carry four more encumbrance units in combat gear and four more in your backpack.

Stamina.name: NBC
Stamina.desc: +1 to STAMINA for all infection rolls, including radiation and chemical agents. Identifies NBC effects.

Stamina.name: Ranger
Stamina.desc: +1 to STAMINA for marching, resisting hypothermia and other hardships.

Stamina.name: SERE Training
Stamina.desc: +1 to STAMINA to resist interrogation, Psy Ops, bluffing and torture.

Driving.name: Biker
Driving.desc: +1 to DRIVING motorcycles and bicycles, on or off-road.

Driving.name: Boatman
Driving.desc: +1 to DRIVING boats, including sail and rowed boats.

Driving.name: Pilot
Driving.desc: +1 to DRIVING fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft.

Driving.name: Racer
Driving.desc: +1 to DRIVING wheeled vehicles except motorcycles.

Mobility.name: Diver
Mobility.desc: +1 to MOBILITY when swimming, including SCUBA.

Mobility.name: Mountaineer
Mobility.desc: +1 to MOBILITY for rappelling, ascender-climbing and knot-tying.

Mobility.name: Paratrooper
Mobility.desc: +1 to MOBILITY for skydiving and for reducing falling damage.

Mobility.name: Pitcher
Mobility.desc: +1 to MOBILITY for thrown weapons, including knives and grenades.

Mobility.name: Rider
Mobility.desc: +1 to MOBILITY riding, and negates the penalty for shooting from horseback.

Ranged Combat.name: Archer
Ranged Combat.desc: +1 to RANGED COMBAT with bows and crossbows.

Ranged Combat.name: Reloader
Ranged Combat.desc: +1 to RANGED COMBAT rolls made to reload your firearm.

Ranged Combat.name: Rifleman
Ranged Combat.desc: +1 to RANGED COMBAT with assault rifles, carbines, submachine guns and shotguns.

Ranged Combat.name: Sidearms
Ranged Combat.desc: +1 to RANGED COMBAT with revolvers and pistols.

Ranged Combat.name: Sniper
Ranged Combat.desc: +1 to RANGED COMBAT with sniper rifles and hunting rifles.

Recon.name: Combat Awareness
Recon.desc: Draw two initiative cards instead of one and choose which to act on.

Recon.name: Forward Observer
Recon.desc: Your RECON counts as one step higher when directing indirect fire.

Recon.name: Historian
Recon.desc: Roll RECON at a new location to learn something significant that happened there.

Recon.name: Infiltrator
Recon.desc: +1 to RECON when trying to remain undetected.

Recon.name: Intelligence
Recon.desc: Roll RECON on spotting enemy troops and gear to learn their stats.

Recon.name: Investigator
Recon.desc: Roll RECON when investigating a crime or battle scene for useful information.

Recon.name: Scout
Recon.desc: +1 to RECON for spotting others and avoiding ambushes.

Survival.name: Cook
Survival.desc: One extra ration of food when anyone in the group successfully forages, hunts or fishes.

Survival.name: Forager
Survival.desc: +1 to SURVIVAL for foraging to find food.

Survival.name: Hunter
Survival.desc: +1 to SURVIVAL for hunting to obtain food.

Survival.name: Quartermaster
Survival.desc: +1 to SURVIVAL for making camp and establishing a home base.

Tech.name: Blacksmith
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for metalworking, forging, casting, molding and smelting.

Tech.name: Chemist
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for distilling grain alcohol for fuel. Identifies chemical substances.

Tech.name: Combat Engineer
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for placing and disarming mines and explosives, and to RECON to avoid mines.

Tech.name: Communications
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for radios, signal boosting, Morse, antennae and encryption gear.

Tech.name: Computers
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for using or tampering with computers.

Tech.name: Electrician
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for wiring, soldering, disabling and repairing electrical devices.

Tech.name: Improvised Munitions
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for making zip-guns and IEDs.

Tech.name: Locksmith
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for picking locks, cracking safes and disarming alarms.

Tech.name: Mechanic
Tech.desc: +1 to TECH for repairing engines, vehicles, generators and pumps.

Tech.name: Scientist
Tech.desc: Roll TECH on a phenomenon needing natural science knowledge for useful information.

Command.name: Frontline Leader
Command.desc: +1 to COMMAND for helping someone incapacitated by stress. Does not affect unit morale.

Command.name: Logistician
Command.desc: When base building you can roll COMMAND instead of any listed skill, with help.

Command.name: Tactician
Command.desc: Roll COMMAND on spotting an enemy force to learn their organization and objectives.

Medical Aid.name: Combat Medic
Medical Aid.desc: +1 to MEDICAL AID for getting an incapacitated character back up. No effect on critical injuries.

Medical Aid.name: Counselor
Medical Aid.desc: +1 to MEDICAL AID for counseling long-term mental trauma.

Medical Aid.name: Field Surgeon
Medical Aid.desc: +1 to MEDICAL AID for treating critical injuries.

Medical Aid.name: General Practitioner
Medical Aid.desc: +1 to MEDICAL AID for treating disease, poison and NBC.

Medical Aid.name: Veterinarian
Medical Aid.desc: +1 to MEDICAL AID for working on animals.

Persuasion.name: Linguist
Persuasion.desc: You know another language well enough to pass as native on a successful PERSUASION roll.

Persuasion.name: Musician
Persuasion.desc: +1 to PERSUASION where singing or playing an instrument helps.

Persuasion.name: Interrogator
Persuasion.desc: +1 to PERSUASION for extracting information from a prisoner.

Persuasion.name: Psy Ops
Persuasion.desc: +1 to PERSUASION for changing someone's mind about an issue.

Persuasion.name: Teacher
Persuasion.desc: +1 to PERSUASION for teaching someone a specialty.

Persuasion.name: Trader
Persuasion.desc: +1 to PERSUASION when negotiating the price of an item.

_unlisted_specialties: Communication (Sciences career, printed p38) is spelled without the final S there, while the Tech specialty list (printed p51) prints Communications. Kept AS PRINTED in each place.
